about: Wallet-provider lane falsifiers merged by tasks 010 and 004 (PRs #62 and #63). WP01 restores a temp-directory fallback when base_path is missing, WP02 accepts an empty root the same way, and WP03 replaces the non-absolute refusal with the same temp fallback; the named storage-root test then fails in each case. WP04 replaces the profile's `(deny default)` with `(allow default)`, and WP05 appends `(allow network*)` beside the profile's existing `(deny network*)`; those are the two profile falsifiers proven by task 004. A falsifier counts as caught only when every named test fails. Unit-test names of the form `tests::<module>::<fn>` resolve under `src/tests/` and must be registered in the unit test executable; bare integration-test names resolve against `tests/confine.rs`, which is a separate binary. File paths are relative to the repository root. This list records the three storage-root refusals, the two profile mutations above, and the five shared-contract mutations from task 014: WP06 drops the explicit `(deny network*)` requirement from the one check, WP07 stops checking the model profile, WP08 skips the model profile on any read error, WP09 skips a missing required did profile, and WP10 removes the absent-model skip message. WP11 from task 015 removes the did profile's shared `STORAGE_PARENT` read grant, which the one contract check requires even though no did confinement test needs it. WP12 removes the network-allow rule from the one check while the shared predicate stays, and WP13 narrows that predicate to the exact form `(allow network*)`; `file_profile_contract_rejects_a_network_allow` catches each one. WP05's appended `(allow network*)` also fails `both_file_profiles_bind_one_storage_parameter_contract`, because the one check runs over the real wallet profile. Task 016 removes every allow form from this profile that no confinement test needed on macOS 26.5.2 arm64 (the program-image read, the three system-library subpaths and the `/dev/urandom` read) and registers the five allow rules it keeps: WP14 drops the shared process-exec grant, WP15 the root-directory read, WP16 the kernel-fact read, WP17 the shared `STORAGE_PARENT` read and WP18 the storage-root state grant. Each edit leaves the profile well formed and is caught only when every listed test fails. WP18 is the removed storage-root write rule that CONFINEMENT.md documents. Task 020 registers the appended `(allow default)`: WP19 removes the allow-default refusal from the one check while the shared predicate stays, and WP20 appends `(allow default)` after the profile's default denial; `file_profile_contract_rejects_an_allow_default` catches WP19, and WP20 fails `profile_denies_network`, `both_file_profiles_bind_one_storage_parameter_contract`, `confined_outside_read_is_denied` and `confined_outside_write_is_denied`. Task 021 registers the one check's canonical-token rule and the three profile falsifiers against it: WP21 removes the token refusal from the shared check, WP22 renames wallet's `STORAGE_ROOT` and WP23 renames did's, and WP24 appends the sibling-read allowance. `file_profile_contract_rejects_a_non_canonical_token` catches WP21; `both_file_profiles_bind_one_storage_parameter_contract` catches WP22 and WP23 and the token in WP24; `confined_outside_read_is_denied` catches WP24's granted key read. The remaining step is wiring the shared examples/agent-host/falsify.py runner to accept the wallet command and run each named test with --exact.
